title: the panel's page for a path it does not have, contract version 1
description: The props of the page for an address below the panel that it has no page for (PRD 13.4), Errors/NotFound in js/panel. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\NotFoundPage, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.
